description: Financial system prioritizes resilience public investment household protection climate readiness and strong oversight.
Households rely heavily on credit amid high housing costs stagnant wages and rising essentials.
Mobile finance social media and automated markets accelerate panic and liquidity flight.
Physical climate risk strains insurance property credit municipal finance and household wealth.
Nonbank leverage private credit redemption pressure and opacity transmit financial stress.
Debt service and weak revenue reduce public capacity when investment is most needed.
Sustainable finance expands but weak standards allow greenwashing speculation and unequal access.
Asset inflation leverage and financial engineering dominate over productive investment.
